title: Expose truthful usage and model observability in the Dashboard
scope: Add a read-only usage and model workspace to the control-plane snapshot and Dashboard using existing provider-reported attribution data.
Preserve unknown values, qualification status, missing-dimension reasons, and model-routing non-authority instead of displaying fabricated savings, cost, or model conclusions.
acceptance_criteria: The live snapshot exposes a bounded usage baseline generated without a model call or canonical-state mutation.
The Dashboard shows qualification progress, Token totals or unknown, completed task coverage, observed models, and usage-driver groups when evidence exists.
The private viewer receives the same bounded read-only usage projection without command, Inbox, prompt, credential, raw provider payload, or mutation authority.
Focused automated tests, full verification, and a narrow-screen runtime review pass at one exact candidate revision.

cancellation_reason: Superseded because global disciplines were incorrectly used for stage-specific Position requirements; no implementation started.

evidence: Superseded because global disciplines were incorrectly used for stage-specific Position requirements; no implementation started.
